title: Bidentate bis(NHC-carboxylate) palladium and nickel complexes for the hydrosilylative reduction of carbonyl compounds
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,16687-16693
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00132G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jorge Sanz-Garrido, Carlos J. Carrasco, Camino Gonzalez-Arellano, Francisco Montilla, Agustín Galindo, Juan C. Flores
Pd(II) and Ni(II) biscarbene complexes bearing κ2-C,O-NHC carboxylate chelating ligands were synthesized and tested in aldehyde and ketone hydrosilylation. The activity showed by a Ni complex is supported by DFT analysis of ligand effects.
